title: The unfinished handoff
body: Do not sell the catch until the county finishes its water check. They called it routine, but the fish order is still in the icebox and the supplier wants payment.
rival_reading: Officials could have restricted food during an emergency; the note never says what the water check was looking for.
gloss: A restaurant order remains unpaid while a routine water check delays the catch.

title: Kept from the drawer
body: The cold-room key is tied to a delivery slip marked received before the road closure. The sealed box is still listed as waiting at the storage units.
rival_reading: A shipment of field supplies could have been delayed or misrouted; the paperwork does not identify the cargo.
gloss: A delivery record marks goods received before access closed, while the box remains uncollected.
